pages.text: $(thing)Stellar Engineering$()$(br2)Ignite a captive star from white-hole ejecta.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): White Holes, Stellar Evolution.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Hawking Emitter.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A captive star of radius R radiates as a black body at surface temperature T.
